title: Fielding Futures
learning_focus: Striking/fielding concepts and skills; active living, teamwork, and decision-making.
story_premise: A future-themed fielding game rewards planning and communication, not only power.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Striking/fielding concepts and skills; active living, teamwork, and decision-making.

areas.title: Strike Lab
areas.story: Control direction and timing. Judge when to advance or remain safe.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Strike Lab.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Striking/fielding concepts and skills, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Striking/fielding concepts and skills.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Strike Lab?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Striking/fielding concepts and skills
Ignore the signs and continue the unsafe behavior.
Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Use the visible health clues before deciding.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Striking/fielding concepts and skills.
questions.correct_feedback: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Striking/fielding concepts and skills.

questions.prompt: Health clues should be observed before the learner chooses an action.

options.text: True
False

questions.first_wrong_hint: Think about why the NPC, environment, or body signal is shown.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.
questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.prompt: Select the two actions that support a safe and healthy decision.

options.text: Use the observed clues.
Choose a safe action or ask a trusted person for help.
Ignore warning signs.
Repeat an unsafe choice to see what happens.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Choose actions that reduce risk and use reliable support.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the learner answers the situation questions?

options.text: Apply the healthy action in the game world and observe the result.
Collect the symbol without helping the NPC or area.
Restart the entire mission after one mistake.
Upload the static question text to the server.

questions.first_wrong_hint: PE & Health requires an applied action, not only a quiz answer.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.
questions.correct_feedback: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.

areas.world_action: Apply a safe, age-appropriate action demonstrating Striking/fielding concepts and skills.
areas.world_result: The NPC or environment in Strike Lab visibly improves after the healthy action.
